profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at EdVisorly
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hi!, I’m a Senior Software Engineer and Founding Engineer based in New York City, with deep experience building full-stack products, AI-powered systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure from concept to production.

Most recently, I designed and built Benji AI from zero to one: a LLM powered full-stack sports betting intelligence platform focused on helping users research NBA and MLB opportunities with more context, speed, and confidence. My work spans product architecture, backend systems, data ingestion, analytics workflows, AI-assisted research, real-time dashboards, authentication, billing, testing, and cloud deployment. A major part of my work has been building practical AI systems that are grounded in real data and designed around user workflows. At Benji AI, I built an AI-powered research experience that helps users explore sports markets, review historical context, evaluate trends, and interact with complex data through a more intuitive product experience. Check out Benji Ai @ getBenjiAi.com

Before Benji AI, I was a Senior Software Engineer at Upstart, where I led automotive integration initiatives across a large dealership network. I built and maintained scalable integration services, internal developer tools, rollback-safe PostgreSQL migrations, and TypeScript/Node.js systems that improved reliability, debugging, and engineering velocity across integration workflows.

Earlier in my career, I served as Lead Full Stack Engineer at Chopra Global, where I built internal integration platforms, automated Salesforce-to-Intacct bookkeeping, and developed a subscription system capable of processing 20,000+ updates in a single run. I also worked as a Full Stack Engineer at COI Energy, building React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL systems for content management, client data, and secure web workflows.

Across my work, I focus on building reliable, scalable, and usable software. My core strengths include TypeScript, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, event-driven architecture, AI-assisted workflows, real-time data ingestion, authentication, billing, testing, and production operations. I enjoy owning complex systems end to end and turning messy data, workflows, and product ideas into software that is fast, dependable, and easy to use.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
-Designed custom CMS platform using PostgreSQL in Node runtime for record consistency and concurrent-request isolation to update and securely maintain client data, request demos, quickly upload articles, images and other content to deployed web applications.

-Implemented mobile-first responsive design with progressive enhancement and graceful degradation of views using Media Queries, Flexbox, and CSS Grid by rapidly animating/collapsing/expanding elements for app-like mobile navigation, improving UI navigation. 

-Created payment and checkout features leveraging third party APIs to securely accept credit/debit, ACH payments, and integrate cached session details with a connected authorized payment gateway, eliminating data re-entry and reducing end-user data-input errors.

-Architected a Node.js server leveraging the Express.js framework to create lightweight Restful APIs that can currently attend to multiple HTTP requests.

-Configured Travis CI in conjunction with test-suites to automate unit, integration, and regression tests mitigating bugs in production.

-Incorporated Bcrypt to secure client passwords in PostgreSQL database by utilizing native one-way hashing algorithm, ensuring best practices in storing sensitive data, protecting against dictionary attacks with salt rounds randomizing authorization flow.
